## `src/manifest`

### buildGhostThemeConfig

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function buildGhostThemeConfig(
  components: readonly ContentComponent[],
  themeName: string,
  diagnostics: CompilerDiagnostic[],
): GhostThemeConfig;
```

Build the `config.custom` fragment from every `@cmsSetting`-tagged field.

Settings are site-wide, so they are keyed by the field's snake_cased prop
name rather than by component: two components tagging the same prop describe
the same knob, and Ghost only has one namespace for them.

#### Parameters

| Name        | Type                        | Description |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | ----------- |
| components  | readonly ContentComponent[] |             |
| themeName   | string                      |             |
| diagnostics | CompilerDiagnostic[]        |             |

### GHOST_SETTING_LIMIT

**Kind:** constant

```typescript
export const GHOST_SETTING_LIMIT;
```

The maximum number of entries Ghost accepts in `config.custom`.

Ghost rejects a theme that exceeds it at upload time, which would turn a
successful Forge build into a failure the author only discovers in Ghost
Admin — hence the truncation and the warning here.

### ghostSettingType

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function ghostSettingType(field: ContentField): GhostSettingType;
```

The Ghost setting type a neutral field kind narrows to.

`color` is part of Ghost's vocabulary but no neutral kind maps onto it: a
colour is an ordinary string in TypeScript and guessing from a prop's name
would make the projection non-deterministic.

#### Parameters

| Name  | Type         | Description |
| ----- | ------------ | ----------- |
| field | ContentField |             |

## `src/template`

### emitGhostPartial

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function emitGhostPartial(component: ContentComponent): string;
```

Emit the Handlebars partial for one component.

The output is deterministic — fields keep their declaration order and slots
trail them — so a regenerated theme produces an empty diff when nothing about
the component changed.

#### Parameters

| Name      | Type             | Description |
| --------- | ---------------- | ----------- |
| component | ContentComponent |             |

### ghostTemplateDiagnostics

**Kind:** function

```typescript
function ghostTemplateDiagnostics(
  component: ContentComponent,
  fileName: string,
): readonly CompilerDiagnostic[];
```

The diagnostics emitting one component's partial produces.

Only `number` is reported: Ghost has no numeric type anywhere in its theme
API, so the value survives as rendered text and any arithmetic a theme wants
to do with it has to happen before the partial is invoked.

#### Parameters

| Name      | Type             | Description |
| --------- | ---------------- | ----------- |
| component | ContentComponent |             |
| fileName  | string           |             |
